### Item 2 — act now / wait / refuse, and eligibility grounds

Act now, after resolving prerequisites in-call.
- Face decrease provision: "A face decrease is processed only while the policy status on record is in force"; the record says `grace_period` -> the root cannot be written as the policy stands.
- Grace: OH is not a listed state -> 31 days ("Grace period | 31 calendar days counted from the unpaid premium's due date"; only CA listed). Unpaid due date = paid-to date 2026-06-15 (the returned 2026-06-15 EFT draft: "the paid-to date moves back to that installment's due date, and the grace period ... is counted from its original due date"). Last day of grace = 2026-06-15 + 31 = 2026-07-16 = today -> "a remittance received on that day is in time". So the grace remittance can still restore the policy today.
- Decrease limits: policy year 21 (issue 2006-07-15) >= "Earliest policy year ... 2"; no completed face decrease in the current policy year (2026-07-15 → 2027-07-14) — the only request is this one; floor: 240000 >= LT25 smallest face 100000.
- Transfer is not warranted: every step has a rule.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only the decrease": excluded by the decrease provision "A face decrease is processed only while the policy status on record is in force" and the P1 hub sentence; the record is `grace_period`.
- Grace remittance before conversion (monthly factor 0.0875, i.e. 132.51 newly due): excluded by the P2 hub sentence (quarterly direct billing first) and by "the modal factor is that of the premium mode on record".
- Grace remittance with the waiver charge still in the newly due installment: excluded by the P2 hub waiver sentence.
- Decrease computed from the pre-removal installment (456.39 or 150.91): excluded by the P1 hub waiver sentence and by "installment premium on record".
- No newly due installment counted: excluded by the count rule ("a full month or more has passed since the latest billed due date and that latest billed installment had been drafted by monthly bank draft (the ledger shows a remittance by bank draft against that due date)") — the eft payment `9181c33f…` against 2026-06-15 is on the ledger.
- Lapsed UL counted toward band / fee share / owner standing: excluded ("only a policy whose status is in force counts").
- Returned-item count excluding the check return: excluded ("whatever the payment method").
- Renewable ladder: excluded (240 whole months < 300).
- Refusal because grace expired: excluded (last day of grace = today, "received on that day is in time").
